items.title: Did Chipotle’s (CMG) “Water Break” Burrito Giveaway and Guac Promo Just Reframe Its Digital Story?

These campaigns highlight Chipotle’s push to deepen digital engagement and capitalize on major sporting and food occasions ahead of its second-quarter earnings release. items.title: Chipotle Stock Is Down 31% in 12 Months – Is It a Buy Ahead of July 29 Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Chipotle's own management spent billions buying back stock at prices well above where shares trade today, and Wall Street analysts see a 43% bounce ahead of this week's earnings report. The question is whether a traffic slump will overshadow the bull case or set up the buying opportunity of the year.
